.  This is an application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. by the aforesaid Applicant, who is facing trial in Spl. POCSO Case No.327 of 2021 pending on the file of the learned Session Court, Gr. Mumbai.

The said case arises from Crime No. 12 of 2021 registered with Dongri Police Station, for offences under Section 376 of the Indian Penal Code and under Section 4, 6, 8 and 12 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012.
